runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game lwar_a83 --rom-path <read-only-rom-root> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/data-east/lwar-a83-switch-test-names.json --output <external-run.json>, run twice from separate empty state directories. The Green and Black service buttons are the only keyboard inputs; every probe is a direct public switch write, held 3 s after a 3 s reference closure of public 9 (public 13 before probing 9). Each snapshot taken while a switch is held records the two sixteen-segment player rows.

run-a.limitation: A reading records the text the ROM prints while one public address is held; it does not prove that a switch is fitted at that address. Public 46 and 47 were not probed because FLIP4746 makes them driver-owned copies of the cabinet flipper buttons.

run-b.note: Independent repeat from its own empty state directory. Every one of the 53 reference closures of public 9 read PLYFLD TILT and the one of public 13 (before probing 9) read OUTHOLE. 54 of 54 probes printed a reading that differs from the reference before them. Its reading at every probed address equals run-a's, checked by tools/data_east_alpha_switch_test_evidence.py from both raw runs.

source.attribution: Successor runs generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes remain external. The original compact readings are preserved, but their original raw traces are unavailable. Both successor runs reproduce those readings. The successor ROM archives differ from the original archives; their members match the pinned driver. Public switch writes are host stimuli, never ROM observations. Display text is decoded from the harness's raw sixteen-segment values; the ROM's font draws O and 0 alike, so a reading keeps the letter the harness table assigns.
source.manifest_algorithm: source.sha256 is SHA-256 of manifest.json's exact UTF-8 bytes. manifest.json is compact canonical JSON with sorted keys, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, plus one LF; it lists every file below source.path except manifest.json and manifest.sha256 as {path, sha256, size}, using sorted POSIX-relative paths.
